candidates.host: One buyer-supplied one-handed caster/healer weapon or two-handed staff with one qualified compatible enchant finish channel. Base weapon and its existing damage/stats are required; the finish replaces a compatible channel.
candidates.wearer_gate: Character level 80; equip the exact qualified caster/healer weapon. Custom response is wearer-only and can trigger only from direct hostile NPC spell damage. Native class, item, level, and channel restrictions still apply.
candidates.artisan_gate: Enchanting 425 minimum, character level 80, this custom pattern taught, and continuously observed work at a real faction-city enchanting station. These are proposed gates; enforce the target server's actual profession/rank/character rules rather than bypassing them.
candidates.unlock: A durable eligible-participation receipt for the exact Classic Azuregos encounter may unlock a city apprenticeship. An allied core-holder separately supplies one real Azuregos Relic Core under an approved custody path. The core is custom and unimplemented; the receipt is neither the core nor a claimed boss drop.

mechanic.trigger: Once per 45 seconds, after the wearer takes one direct spell-damage hit from a hostile non-player character while this exact weapon is equipped.
mechanic.effect: Consume one charge to reduce the next direct hostile NPC spell hit against the wearer by 12% within 5 seconds. No reflection, ally effect, immunity, or damage nullification.

native_stat_effect_adapter.note: Custom event/effect has no admitted native stat channel or spell ID.

numbers.stacking: One copy of this family can be active per wearer; identical effects do not multiply. This 24-charge item reservoir limits only this effect's individual potency, not the character's earned encounters or overall progression.

mechanic.empty_behavior: The compatible ordinary item baseline remains; the custom response is dormant at zero charges. Unequip, death, relog, bank, mail, trade, and restart do not refill or reset the item-bound charge/cooldown ledger.

installation.anchor: One existing configured territorial objective or supply-route checkpoint with stable site identity. If the site fixture/record is not admitted, installation is blocked.
installation.authorization: The current territory/route owner and its authorized guild representative approve the exact site and version. A locally present authorized installer records the real install action; neither an order nor proximity teleports or places the ward.
installation.city_station: The enchanter works at an admitted station inside the faction city. A real allied engineer or blacksmith makes/installs the mount on site as a separately tracked custody step; city production and field installation are separate.
installation.inventory_custody: Reserve each listed input from the owning account's available guild inventory, preserving original stack/GUID provenance. Consume it once at the accepted stage; reserved goods cannot also be withdrawn for troop kits or another order. There is no automatic restock.
installation.food_and_artillery: The ward creates no food, rations, weapons, armor, ammunition, artillery, troops, or replacements. Existing squads still consume their ordinary one ration per living troop at battle entry and retain only their original issued kits. A ward cannot upgrade kit grade or artillery stock.
installation.effect_scope: Site-local only. Apply to the exact objective/checkpoint and verified actor/event specified by the selected adapter; no global radar or arbitrary off-site coverage.

ownership.custody: The installed fixture remains anchored to its site; its ledger retains original maker, material lots, former owner, charges, and installation identity.
ownership.capture_behavior: A committed owner/version change makes the ward dormant and revokes the former owner's operational authority. Capture alone does not move guild inventory, transfer reservations, refill charges, install another ward, or grant the new owner a free service.
ownership.next_service: The new owner may authorize a paid rebind/recharge only after its own control version is current, using its own available materials at the exact ordinary recharge bill/time. That service restores only the listed charge count up to capacity; no boss core is required.
ownership.no_seizure: The new owner cannot withdraw the previous owner's stock or claim the old guild's maker/material provenance. Unknown custody or unresolved reservations remain held for reconciliation.

candidates.name: Ram-Break Grounding Ward
candidates.source_encounter: A future authoritative siege-action event at one installed territorial objective; no boss encounter.
candidates.host: One non-wearable grounding fixture at one configured site with an admitted siege-action record.
candidates.wearer_gate: Not wearable. It can affect only an existing hostile siege squad/action verified against this exact site and owner/version; no hero weapon or attack bonus.
candidates.artisan_gate: Level 80 city enchanter with Enchanting 400 minimum and custom pattern; an allied engineer/blacksmith with skill 400 minimum builds and installs the mount after current site authorization.
candidates.unlock: Custom apprenticeship follows a useful owner-accepted ward service. Siege actions are not yet in the territorial army model, so the pattern stays locked until a real action/event and ownership adapter exist.

mechanic.trigger: Once per 900 seconds on the first authoritative hostile siege-action event against the exact installed objective, after siege events are separately admitted.
mechanic.effect: Consume one charge without cancelling the action or creating a weapon. Campaign mode applies -1 campaign attack point per original living hostile attacker for the next 2 rounds; physical mode instead reduces the next admitted siege-NPC damage event by 5% for 10 seconds within 20 yards. Never both.

numbers.adapter_selection: Choose campaign policy or physical actor mode for this event; the numeric versions are alternatives and never stack.

campaign_npc_points_adapter.troop_source: exact original hostile troop IDs in verified siege battle

native_stat_effect_adapter.actor_scope: existing hostile NPC identities registered to the admitted siege event

mechanic.empty_behavior: At zero charges the ward cannot disrupt or delay an action. A siege event is not cancelled, blocked, or falsely settled because a fixture exists.

stages.name: Forge grounding frame/anchor plate at city station
Bind shock-diffusion line to the proposed local action family
Inspect and hand over site/version install packet and charge custody

candidates.teaching: City mentor teaches only after a separate useful order and owner-accepted site order. Until siege state is supported, apprenticeship authorizes no fictional siege or battle.
candidates.maker_reward: One accepted useful installation may earn one custom non-combat signature/mastery record per artisan/design. Provenance only; no native skill, XP, reputation, siege credit, or free craft mastery.
bot_rules: Enchanter works at an actual city station; authorized engineer/blacksmith separately installs on site.
This proposal does not issue siege orders, spawn artillery, move squads, or simulate a siege.
Selected adapter may run only after the exact hostile event, roster, ownership, supplies, and battle settlement are approved.
abuse_rules: No effect on players, heroes, friendly/unverified units, unsupplied squads, unrelated NPCs, or unverified actions.
No cancellation, guaranteed defense, immunity, artillery creation, replacement, free ward, or unearned capture.
Consume a charge once per original event; stale/duplicate/unknown physical evidence holds for reconciliation.
Never apply campaign attack points and native damage reduction in the same resolution.
dependencies: Territorial armies documentation marks sieges as later work. Until an authoritative siege event exists, this ward has no trigger and cannot be installed for use.
Physical mode requires an existing siege actor/action and qualified native effect mapping; this record creates neither.

installation.anchor: One existing configured territorial objective or supply-route checkpoint with stable site identity. If the site fixture/record is not admitted, installation is blocked.
installation.authorization: The current territory/route owner and its authorized guild representative approve the exact site and version. A locally present authorized installer records the real install action; neither an order nor proximity teleports or places the ward.
installation.city_station: The enchanter works at an admitted station inside the faction city. A real allied engineer or blacksmith makes/installs the mount on site as a separately tracked custody step; city production and field installation are separate.
installation.inventory_custody: Reserve each listed input from the owning account's available guild inventory, preserving original stack/GUID provenance. Consume it once at the accepted stage; reserved goods cannot also be withdrawn for troop kits or another order. There is no automatic restock.
installation.food_and_artillery: The ward creates no food, rations, weapons, armor, ammunition, artillery, troops, or replacements. Existing squads still consume their ordinary one ration per living troop at battle entry and retain only their original issued kits. A ward cannot upgrade kit grade or artillery stock.
installation.effect_scope: Site-local only. Apply to the exact objective/checkpoint and verified actor/event specified by the selected adapter; no global radar or arbitrary off-site coverage.

ownership.custody: The installed fixture remains anchored to its site; its ledger retains original maker, material lots, former owner, charges, and installation identity.
ownership.capture_behavior: A committed owner/version change makes the ward dormant and revokes the former owner's operational authority. Capture alone does not move guild inventory, transfer reservations, refill charges, install another ward, or grant the new owner a free service.
ownership.next_service: The new owner may authorize a paid rebind/recharge only after its own control version is current, using its own available materials at the exact ordinary recharge bill/time. That service restores only the listed charge count up to capacity; no boss core is required.
ownership.no_seizure: The new owner cannot withdraw the previous owner's stock or claim the old guild's maker/material provenance. Unknown custody or unresolved reservations remain held for reconciliation.

candidates.name: Caravan Shelter Ward
candidates.source_encounter: Verified arrival of one original carrier and cargo manifest at the installed supply-route checkpoint; no boss encounter.
candidates.host: One non-wearable shelter fixture at one existing configured caravan checkpoint, bound to that route version.
candidates.wearer_gate: Not wearable. Only the original carrier and already assigned existing escorts on the exact owner-authorized route can benefit; cargo, rations, and troop kits do not.
candidates.artisan_gate: Level 80 city enchanter with Enchanting 400 minimum and custom pattern; a separately ordered level 80 engineer/blacksmith with skill 400 minimum installs after current route owner approves the exact checkpoint.
candidates.unlock: Custom apprenticeship requires an accepted useful supply-service order for an actual manifest/route shortage and an authorized owner. It does not complete delivery, settle payment, or reward a boss.

mechanic.trigger: Once per 300 seconds after the original authorized carrier reaches this checkpoint with the original manifest in verified custody.
mechanic.effect: Consume one charge at verified arrival. Physical mode shelters the original carrier and assigned escorts within 15 yards for 10 seconds. Campaign mode grants +1 campaign armor point to exact registered living escorts for the first 2 rounds only when a route-defense battle for this same site/version is already starting in that arrival event; otherwise the campaign effect expires immediately. Nothing is stored for an unrelated future battle. No cargo, food, health, or charge is created; the caravan can still be intercepted or lost.

numbers.adapter_selection: Use only one resolution mode; campaign points do not convert to native stats.

campaign_npc_points_adapter.battle_binding: same site/version and already-starting battle at the arrival event; no deferred effect
campaign_npc_points_adapter.troop_source: exact already registered escort IDs, if any

native_stat_effect_adapter.actor_scope: original carrier plus exact assigned existing escort actors

mechanic.empty_behavior: Shelter is inactive at zero charges. Manifest, carrier, food, and escorts still follow ordinary supply/army rules; unresolved custody remains held.

stages.name: Prepare shelter frame at city station
Bind checkpoint resonance to one exact route version
Inspect manifest rules and hand over owner install packet

candidates.teaching: Teach only through a distinct accepted city apprenticeship attached to an ordinary useful order and a real supply contract/route need. It changes no native profession skill or contract state.
candidates.maker_reward: An owner-accepted useful installation may earn one custom non-combat maker signature/mastery record per artisan/design tied to route version, site, original lots, and contributors. Recharges/deliveries award no craft mastery, native skill, XP, or reputation.
bot_rules: Enchanter stays at city station; a local authorized installer separately completes the real checkpoint installation.
Cargo remains the same original reserved manifest. Ward cannot skip checkpoints, mark Delivered, release holds, mint rations, or refund a loss.
Only the original carrier and escort identities qualify; replacement actors cannot inherit an old effect.
abuse_rules: Trigger only from authoritative checkpoint receipt with current owner/version and full manifest custody; proximity/time is not proof.
No guaranteed delivery, invulnerability, cargo restoration, free escort, food, kit, or passive stock generation.
Persist charge/cooldown on exact site across capture/restart; stale or unknown cargo remains held.
Never stack campaign armor with native reduction or duplicate two ward effects for one event.
dependencies: Requires exact route-version checkpoint and trusted original manifest/carrier custody from supply-contract policy.
Campaign and physical versions are alternatives; no effect is admitted until the adapter proves actor identity, event uniqueness, and lifecycle.
